edges.relationship: Tyrrell identifies Charles and Mary Beard’s large-scale historical narrative as a rhetorical resource for Wiebe’s Search for Order.

edges.relationship: Wiebe questions Mosse’s characterization of racism as heightened nationalism within a broader criticism of treating nationalism as pathology.
